records.title: Extracting Text Files to JSON
records.integration_role: provenance context for previously extracted text-to-JSON materials
records.observed_context: Task shows prior extraction of multiple pasted text attachments and a large artifact set. Current raw upload files are preserved independently rather than assuming task artifacts are authoritative.
limitations: Task artifacts were not treated as duplicate canonical sources without a retained source file and hash in the current repository.

records.title: Astrology Chart Analysis Website Using Provided Source
records.observed_context: Task describes a chart-analysis application with chart calculation, source-framework loading, provenance-sensitive uploads, and interpretation UI features.
limitations: Website implementation claims are not used as evidence for calculation accuracy or interpretive validity.

records.title: Astrodash Manus Space URL
reviewed_artifacts: user-supplied Astrodash export in current batch
records.observed_context: Task includes application code and dashboard features; current batch includes a dashboard export containing personally identifying birth-chart material.
limitations: Personal chart placements and derived descriptions are retained as source material only and are excluded from generalized corpus records.

records.title: Astrology Compendium expanded
records.observed_context: Task is a multi-segment prior compendium workflow. Its visible latest segment establishes that it was a separate implementation context rather than a substitute for current source hashes.
limitations: No un-hashed prior task output is silently promoted into the current canonical corpus.

records.title: Solar Arcs Delineation Methodology Framework Overview
records.observed_context: Task supplied a Solar Arcs methodology proposal including an arc rule, orbital tolerance, weighting, and confirmation assumptions.
limitations: Weights, orb policy, probability-style multipliers, and confirmation boosts remain methodology-bound and are not treated as computed truth, empirical probability, or a calculation adapter.

records.title: Detailed Delineation Framework from Esoteric Astrology PDF
records.observed_context: Task began with a supplied Bepin Behari esoteric astrology PDF. The current batch provides text extraction from that source for source-grounded retrieval.
limitations: Esoteric interpretation remains retrieval-only and is never injected into Western, Vedic, or standard calculation engines.
